description: Manual QA checklist — mirrors automated visual regression; run before releases
prerequisites: npm run build && npm run preview
Load seed: DevTools → Application → localStorage → ft_v5 (paste from spec/visual-seed-data.json, replace SEED_TODAY with today's locale date string)

items.check: Header shows Orbius wordmark with gradient infinity icon
Gear icon at the top-right of the header opens Settings; Esc closes
Settings Profile sex/height/age prefills Body Comp log form
Settings calorie goal and activity persist and seed the Calories page
Export JSON downloads a backup that includes InBody fields on bodyComp; Import asks to confirm replace; Wipe all logs asks for confirm and keeps settings
Five nav tabs visible; active tab has purple pill
Press 1–5 switches tabs (when no modal open)
Dark background (#0f0f13), readable text, accent purple on active elements
Four stat boxes: Body Weight, Body Fat, Today Cals, Workouts
Personal Records lists Squat 100kg, Bench Press 80kg, Overhead Press 50kg
Expand Recent Workouts — shows latest sessions with set summaries
Hero shows a filled stat strip: workout count, unique count, and today's date
Open Calendar — month grid, logged days highlighted
Day panel trash opens Delete this workout? on a layer above the day panel; Esc/Cancel returns to the day, not the month grid
Smart Parser modal opens; Enter parses, Esc closes
Workout History Newest-by-date shows latest DD-MM-YYYY day first; search matches exercise name or date; Collapse all stays collapsed when switching Date / Workout
Log Entry expand — typing weight/BF updates live metrics
History shows saved entry with metric chips including InBody extras (score, visceral, water, protein, mineral, BMR) when those fields exist
History Import InBody CSV parses the export, asks to confirm, merges scans by date without touching workouts, keeps the latest same-day reading, and reports skipped incomplete rows
Editing an InBody History row keeps score/segmental extras and InBody BMR
Logging body comp on a date that already exists replaces that day instead of adding a second row
History shows a segmental lean/fat body map for the latest InBody scan that has arm/trunk/leg values; the card stays hidden without those fields
BMR & TDEE show values when body comp exists, including TEF/NEAT/EAT/PAEE breakdown
Daily goal progress bar reflects logged calories
Food log lists seeded entries for selected date
Compound lift charts render with data points
Toggle Max Weight / Volume / e1RM — line morphs smoothly (~600ms)
Progress shows a BODY section label with extra space and a divider after workout charts, before Body Weight
Body Weight chart shows a Body Weight (kg) label above the plot, matching BMI; BMI appears when that field exists
Progress shows one Fat Mass & Body Fat % card with Fat Mass, Body Fat %, and FMI stacked when those fields exist; empty series stay hidden
Progress shows one Skeletal Muscle Mass & SMI card with Skeletal Muscle Mass, Muscle Mass %, and SMI stacked when those fields exist; empty series stay hidden
Progress shows one Fat-Free Mass & FFMI card with Fat-Free Mass, Fat-Free Mass %, and FFMI stacked when those fields exist; empty series stay hidden

Progress shows one Segmental Analysis card with a Soft Lean Mass / Fat Mass toggle on a body-shaped grid when InBody segmental fields exist; Soft Lean Mass charts are crimson and Fat Mass charts are yellow; the unused metric and empty regions stay hidden; arms share a Y-axis and legs share a Y-axis
Progress shows one Visceral Fat Level card after Segmental Analysis when visceral exists; the card stays hidden when the series is empty
Progress shows one Water, Protein & Mineral card with Total Body Water, Protein, and Mineral charts stacked when those InBody fields exist; empty series stay hidden
Progress shows one BMR card just above InBody Score when BMR exists; the card stays hidden when the series is empty
Progress shows one InBody Score card below Water, Protein & Mineral when score exists; the card stays hidden when the series is empty
Click chart point → Workout Details panel opens
Refresh page — all data persists
localStorage key is ft_v5
